citation: i2spec, our own direct-potential fit (2026-09-21). Start: the Gerstenkorn & Luc 1985 Dunham constants inverted by RKR; long-range coefficients from Bacis, Cerny & Martin 1986 (X) and Gerstenkorn, Luc & Amiot 1985 (B), the X ones refined here within their stated uncertainties. No Hannover parameter was used at any stage.
fitted_to: 40 578 of our own measured line positions: 39 757 atlas centres (data/atlas_lines, two FTS atlases, each with a fitted offset and scale) and 821 precision positions including the v'' = 48-54 emission lines, whose X levels were bridged across the unmeasured gap by prototypes/x_bridge.py. prototypes/global_fit.py, docs/design/global-fit.md. Converged 2026-09-21 with 200 optimiser evaluations per homotopy stage (the run before it stopped at 30 and was not converged), and a 30 MHz model-error floor on the v'' > 17 rows: without one, 36 rows the model cannot reach at their own kHz spend the 40 000 it can.
status: research result. Better than the published potentials by 130-430x wherever they leave their data (v' > 43, v'' > 17) and 10-20x worse inside it, where a single smooth MLR reaches 18-24 MHz against their 1-5. Calibration fitted alongside: Salami-Ross +4.3 MHz and +33.7 ppb, APO -2.4 MHz and -10.5 ppb.
